description: Create a standalone advertisement from the supplied creative, targeting and budget in the selected connected ad account. Quote first by calling without confirm:true. Show the returned spending preview and obtain owner approval before confirming with the same requestId. Retain that requestId for soclo_ads_operation_status after an uncertain result; never automatically repeat a purchase. Report the returned status without claiming the ad is live until active. Confirmed creation requests active status; platform review may delay delivery. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_create_standalone_ad.
